    (hp : Summable fun k => ‖p k‖ * Real.exp (|2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log r| / 2))
    (hphase : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' k : ℤ, p k * cexp (((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log r * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n → lam n = ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) ∧ RiemannHypothesis

    (hphase : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t →
      cexp (((2 * Real.pi * quantizationResidualCumulative hW t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) =
        ∑' k : ℤ, p k * cexp (((2 * (k : ℝ) * Real.log r * t : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)) :

by
  rcases quantization_rigidity_or_rational_period_power hW with hR | hpower
  · exact hR
  rcases quantization_rigidity_or_rational_harmonics hW with hR | hrat
  · exact hR
  obtain ⟨N, m, n, hN, _, _, he⟩ := hpower r hr p hp hphase
  have he' : r ^ N = ((m : ℚ) / n : ℚ) := by simpa only [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_natCast] using he
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ⟨q, hq⟩, hgen⟩ :=
    quantization_rational_exponent_generator (by omega : 0 < N) he' (by linarith : 0 < r)
  have hq1 : 1 < (q : ℝ) := by
    rw [hq, Real.one_lt_exp_iff]
    exact mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast ha) (Real.log_pos hr)
  obtain ⟨hp', hseries⟩ := quantization_periodic_reindex ha hq hp
    (fun k hk => (hgen k).mp (hrat r hr p hp hphase k hk))
  exact quantization_rigidity_of_rat_periodic_phase hW hq1 hp'
    (fun t ht => (hphase t ht).trans (hseries t))

source_arguments.proof_excerpt:
by
  let a := dirichletExp (lamLog lam)
  let β := betaG (quantizationCompletion hW)
  let c := quantizationResidualPhase hW
  let κ := c⁻¹
  let Φ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => quantizationTraceF hW (2 * t)
  let Ψ : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => quantizationReflectedTraceF hW (2 * t)
  let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun t => Φ t - Ψ t
  let e := quantizationReflectionError hW
  have hΦm : Measurable Φ :=
    (measurable_quantizationTraceF hW).comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)
  have hΨm : Measurable Ψ :=
    (measurable_quantizationReflectedTraceF hW).comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id)
  have hem : Measurable e := measurable_quantizationReflectionError hW
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hB⟩ := exists_quantization_trace_pair_bound hW
  have hΦb : ∀ t, ‖Φ t‖ ≤ (2 * C) * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by
    intro t
    have := (hB t).1
    have hp : 0 ≤ C * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hΨb : ∀ t, ‖Ψ t‖ ≤ (2 * C) * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by
    intro t
    have := (hB t).2
    have hp : 0 ≤ C * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by positivity
    linarith
  have heb : ∀ t, ‖e t‖ ≤ (2 * C) * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by
    intro t
    calc ‖e t‖ ≤ ‖Ψ t‖ + ‖c * Φ t‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = ‖Ψ t‖ + ‖Φ t‖ := by rw [norm_mul, norm_quantizationResidualPhase, one_mul]
      _ ≤ (2 * C) * (1 + |t|) ^ (1 : ℕ) := by linarith [(hB t).1, (hB t).2]
  have ha := fun σ hσ => quantization_coeff_summable hW (σ := σ) hσ
  have ha2 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ‖a (n + 1)‖ / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa using summable_sq_of_forall_rpow ha
  let S : ℂ → ℂ := fun τ => ∑' n : ℕ, a (n + 1) * cexp (-(2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * τ))
  let K : ℂ → ℂ := fun τ => -κ * defectLaplace e τ
  have hκ : κ * c = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (quantizationResidualPhase_ne_zero hW)
  have hmain : ∀ τ : ℂ, 0 < τ.re →
      hamburgerSeries a τ = κ * S τ - κ * β / Real.pi / τ + β + K τ := by
    intro τ hτ
    have eA := quantization_hamburgerSeries_reflection hW hτ
    have eB := quantization_hamburgerSeries_eq hW hτ
    have eC := defectLaplace_indicator_eq (g := g) hΨm.aestronglyMeasurable hΨb
      hΦm.aestronglyMeasurable hΦb MeasurableSet.univ (-1)
      (fun t _ => by dsimp [g]; ring) hτ
    have eD := defectLaplace_indicator_eq (g := Ψ) hΦm.aestronglyMeasurable hΦb
      hem.aestronglyMeasurable heb MeasurableSet.univ c
      (fun t _ => by dsimp [e, Ψ, Φ, c, quantizationReflectionError]; ring) hτ
    simp only [indicator_univ] at eC eD
    change hamburgerSeries a τ = S τ - β / (Real.pi * τ) + β + defectLaplace g τ at eA
    change hamburgerSeries a τ = β + defectLaplace Φ τ at eB
    rw [show β / (Real.pi * τ) = β / Real.pi / τ by field_simp] at eA
    dsimp only [K]
    linear_combination κ * eA - (κ - 1) * eB + κ * eC - κ * eD -
      defectLaplace Φ τ * hκ
  have hper : ∀ τ : ℂ, 0 < τ.re → hamburgerSeries a (τ + I) - hamburgerSeries a τ =
      -(κ * β / Real.pi) / (τ + I) - -(κ * β / Real.pi) / τ + (K (τ + I) - K τ) := by
    intro τ hτ
    have hτ' : 0 < (τ + I).re := by simpa using hτ
    have hexp : S (τ + I) = S τ := by
      dsimp only [S]
      refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
      rw [show -(2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * (τ + I)) =
        -(2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * τ) + ((-((n : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℂ) * (2 * Real.pi * I) by
          push_cast; ring, Complex.exp_add, Complex.exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]
    rw [hmain τ hτ, hmain (τ + I) hτ', hexp]
    ring
  have hKrad : ∀ m : ℕ, Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ => (ε : ℂ) * K ((ε : ℂ) + (m : ℂ) * I))
      (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    intro m
    have h := (tendsto_quantization_reflection_error_radial hW hfin m).const_mul (-κ)
    rw [mul_zero] at h
    exact h.congr' (Eventually.of_forall fun ε => by dsimp [K, e]; ring)
  have hK : ∀ n₀ : ℕ, Tendsto (fun τ => (τ - (n₀ : ℂ) * I) * (K (τ + I) - K τ))
      (𝓝[{τ : ℂ | 0 < τ.re}] ((n₀ : ℂ) * I)) (𝓝 0) := by
    intro n₀
    refine tendsto_sub_mul_defect_of_radial ha2 (-(κ * β / Real.pi))
      (fun τ => K (τ + I) - K τ) hper n₀ ?_

/-
# Guinand--Weil codiagonal observer dimension

At Galerkin level `N`, the zero-to-positive codiagonal of a source-reflection imbalance observes
exactly `N` sine moments.  The square rigidity theorem therefore has a sharp dimension boundary.
For at most `N` distinct nondegenerate reflection orbits, vanishing of all `N` observed moments
forces every imbalance coefficient to vanish.  For more than `N` orbits, rank--nullity forces a
nonzero imbalance invisible to the entire codiagonal observer, for every placement of the horizons.

This is the finite-dimensional source of selection ambiguity in overcomplete prime packets and
continuous pole/archimedean measures.  It does not say that the whole event matrix vanishes: its
diagonal also observes the weighted cosine coordinates in Groskin's `2N+1` source quotient.  Thus
the result locates, rather than assumes away, the exact source information lost by the codiagonal.
-/
import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.CCMGuinandWeilReflectionOddRigidity
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace RHTower

open Matrix

/-- Rectangular sine-moment observer with `N` modes and `R` event orbits. -/
def ccmGuinandWeilRectangularSineMomentMatrix {N R : ℕ}
    (angle : Fin R → ℝ) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin R) ℝ :=
  fun k i => Real.sin (((k : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * angle i)

/-- **Undercomplete codiagonal rigidity.**  If the number of nondegenerate event orbits does not
exceed the number of observed positive modes, every vanishing imbalance is zero. -/
theorem ccmGuinandWeilRectangularSineMoment_rigidity_of_le
    {N R : ℕ} (hRN : R ≤ N) (angle : Fin R → ℝ)
    (hcos : Function.Injective (fun i => Real.cos (angle i)))
    (hsin : ∀ i, Real.sin (angle i) ≠ 0)
    (imbalance : Fin R → ℝ)
    (hmoment : ∀ k : Fin N,
      ∑ i, imbalance i * Real.sin (((k : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * angle i) = 0) :
    imbalance = 0 := by
  apply ccmGuinandWeilSineMoment_rigidity angle hcos hsin
  intro k
  let kN : Fin N := ⟨k, lt_of_lt_of_le k.isLt hRN⟩
  simpa [kN] using hmoment kN

/-- **Overcomplete codiagonal kernel.**  More event orbits than positive modes always produce a
nonzero reflection imbalance invisible to every observed sine moment. -/
theorem ccmGuinandWeilRectangularSineMoment_exists_nonzero_kernel
    {N R : ℕ} (hNR : N < R) (angle : Fin R → ℝ) :
    ∃ imbalance : Fin R → ℝ, imbalance ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ k : Fin N,
        ∑ i, imbalance i *
          Real.sin (((k : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * angle i) = 0 := by
  let T : (Fin R → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] (Fin N → ℝ) :=
    (ccmGuinandWeilRectangularSineMomentMatrix angle).mulVecLin
  have hdimension :
      Module.finrank ℝ (Fin N → ℝ) < Module.finrank ℝ (Fin R → ℝ) := by
    simpa using hNR
  have hker : LinearMap.ker T ≠ ⊥ :=
    T.ker_ne_bot_of_finrank_lt hdimension
  obtain ⟨imbalance, himbalance, hne⟩ :=
    Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hker
  refine ⟨imbalance, hne, fun k => ?_⟩
  have hzero : T imbalance = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp himbalance
  have hk := congr_fun hzero k
  simpa [T, ccmGuinandWeilRectangularSineMomentMatrix,
    Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, mul_comm] using hk

/-- Paired event packet with `R` reflection orbits carried by modes `0,...,N`. -/
def ccmGuinandWeilRectangularPairedEventPacketMatrix {N R : ℕ}
    (forward reflected horizon : Fin R → ℝ) :
    Matrix (Fin (N + 1)) (Fin (N + 1)) ℝ :=
  ∑ r, (forward r •
      ccmGuinandWeilEventMatrix
        (fun j : Fin (N + 1) => (j : ℤ)) (horizon r) +
    reflected r •
      ccmGuinandWeilEventMatrix
        (fun j : Fin (N + 1) => (j : ℤ)) (1 - horizon r))

/-- Literal codiagonal edge law for the rectangular paired packet. -/
theorem ccmGuinandWeilRectangularPairedEventPacketMatrix_zero_edge
    {N R : ℕ} (forward reflected horizon : Fin R → ℝ) (k : Fin N) :
    ccmGuinandWeilRectangularPairedEventPacketMatrix
        forward reflected horizon (Fin.succ k) 0 =
      (∑ r, (forward r - reflected r) *
        Real.sin (((k : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi * horizon r))) /
          (Real.pi * ((k : ℕ) + 1 : ℝ)) := by
  rw [ccmGuinandWeilRectangularPairedEventPacketMatrix, Matrix.sum_apply]
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [ccmGuinandWeilEventMatrix, ccmDividedDifferenceMatrix,
    Fin.succ_ne_zero, if_false]
  simp_rw [ccmGuinandWeilEventSource_one_sub]
  simp [ccmGuinandWeilEventSource]
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [show 2 * Real.pi * horizon r * (((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) =
    (((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (2 * Real.pi * horizon r) by ring]
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero, ne_of_gt hkpos]
  ring

/-- More than `N` reflection orbits admit unequal forward/reflected weights whose entire
zero-to-positive codiagonal vanishes.  No horizon collision or endpoint is required. -/
theorem
